decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and installing new building pressure and vacuum relief valves.

items.material_name: Building pressure/vacuum relief valve, ±650 Pa, minimum 900 m³/h, 1.4301 stainless steel housing, DN 200 branch connection
items.description: Maintenance-free valve with a matching pipe branch, flange or restrained coupling, seals, and fasteners.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new thermal mass flowmeter supplied as an assembly with its calibrated measuring section.

items.material_name: DN 200 thermal air mass flowmeter assembly, 0–10,000 Nm³/h, 350 mm measuring section, IP65, 24 V DC, 4–20 mA
items.description: Compact meter with a fouling-resistant sensor and a matched, calibrated precision flow section with DIN EN 1092-1 Form A flanges.

decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and assembling a new big-bag discharging station; the valve and stand are included components.

items.material_name: BBE-2.1-type low-profile big-bag discharging station, 1.4301 stainless steel, 1190 mm high, 350 mm lift, for bags up to 120 × 100 cm
items.description: Bead-blasted station with gas-spring lift, long BIDV-7.1-S-S rope-iris dosing valve, and approximately 1200 mm support stand.

decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and installing a new stationary liquid-jet solids pump.

items.material_name: Stationary liquid-jet solids pump, FFeP type, order no. 181001 473195 or equivalent
items.description: Fixed-installation liquid-jet pump for solids handling, supplied ready for operation.

decisions.reason: The position requires supplying and installing a new water-jet aerator; testing, documentation, and commissioning are included.

items.material_name: DN 150 water-jet aerator, 60 m³/h motive water, 120 Nm³/h air, 1.4571 stainless steel, DN 100 PN 16 inlet, DN 150 PN 10 discharge
items.description: Vertical raw-water deacidification and aeration ejector with replaceable motive nozzle, DN 80 suction throttle, and 1.4541 loose discharge flange.

decisions.reason: The position requires new filter nozzles in addition to removal and disposal of the existing nozzles.

items.material_name: S3-type air-cushion filter nozzle, minimum 2 mm air slot and working bore, minimum 5 mm height adjustment
items.description: Replacement nozzle for an open filter bed, with a burr-free air slot and working bore.

decisions.reason: The position requires two new filter media supplied in separately quantified layers.

items.material_name: DIN 12904 washed and flame-dried quartz support gravel, 2.00–3.15 mm, 30 cm layer
items.description: Support media for the open arsenic-removal filter.

items.material_name: GEH 102 granular ferric hydroxide arsenic adsorbent, 1.20 m filter layer
items.description: Arsenic-removal media delivered in big bags for hydraulic placement in the open filter.
